title.english: The Empty Place on the Shelf

pairs.target: pà wò xiān jiē suāncài , hòu jiē tǎ wéi .
pairs.english: Pavo welcomed the pickled vegetables first, and Tavi second.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃先接酸菜，后接塔维。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐbāo bào dào xiōngqián , wén le yíxià , cái téngchū yìzhī shǒu pāi tǎ wéi de jiān , shuō huílái de zhènghǎo , wǎnfàn de dòuzǐ yòu dùn chéng le ní .
pairs.english: He hugged the packet to his chest and sniffed it, then freed a hand to pat Tavi's shoulder, saying he was just in time: the dinner beans had turned to mush again.
pairs.hanzi: 他把纸包抱到胸前，闻了一下，才腾出一只手拍塔维的肩，说回来得正好，晚饭的豆子又炖成了泥。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiào tā xiān bǎ zhǎolíng shōu hǎo , bié chī dào yíbàn cái shuō zìjǐ zhī tuōmǎi le yìbāo .
pairs.english: Tavi told him to put away the change first, not claim halfway through eating that he'd only ordered one packet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维叫他先把找零收好，别吃到一半才说自己只托买了一包。

pairs.target: huíchéng méiyǒu xiàxuě , chē què zài pō shàng děng le bàngè zhōngtóu , ràng yíduì yùn mù de xiān guò .
pairs.english: There had been no snow on the return journey, but the cart waited half an hour on a slope to let a timber convoy pass first.
pairs.hanzi: 回程没有下雪，车却在坡上等了半个钟头，让一队运木的先过。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiānbǎng bèibāo dài lè dé fāsuān .
pairs.english: The bag strap had left Tavi's shoulder aching.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维肩膀被包带勒得发酸。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhōushīfu huà de nàge xiǎogé jiá jìn běnzi , yā zài zhěnbiān , xiǎng děng xǐwán liǎn zài qù zhǎo yīwén .
pairs.english: He tucked Master Zhou's little compartment sketch into his notebook beside the pillow, planning to find Iven after washing his face.
pairs.hanzi: 他把周师傅画的那个小格夹进本子，压在枕边，想等洗完脸再去找伊文。

pairs.target: mǐlā què xiān lái le .
pairs.english: But Mira came first.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉却先来了。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài ménkǒu , méiyǒu jìnwū , wèn tā jì bu jìde zhé tiě cáo shí yòng le nǎ liǎngpiàn liào .
pairs.english: Standing in the doorway without coming in, she asked if he remembered which two offcuts he had used to bend the iron channel.
pairs.hanzi: 她站在门口，没有进屋，问他记不记得折铁槽时用了哪两片料。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi móxíng yòu kǎ le , ná shàng wàiyī gēn tā zǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi thought the model had jammed again, took his coat, and followed her.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为模型又卡了，拿上外衣跟她走。

pairs.target: dào le běi gōngfáng , tā cái kànjiàn jiàzi shàngkōng chūlái de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Only at the north workshop did he see the empty place on the shelf.
pairs.hanzi: 到了北工房，他才看见架子上空出来的地方。

pairs.target: hóngbùtiáo hái zài , juàn chéng yìtuán , yā zài yígè tā méi jiàn guò de mùlún xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: The red cloth strip remained, rolled up under a wooden wheel he had never seen.
pairs.hanzi: 红布条还在，卷成一团，压在一个他没见过的木轮下面。

pairs.target: qiáo bú zài le .
pairs.english: The bridge was gone.
pairs.hanzi: 桥不在了。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ mùlún yíkāi , ná qǐ bùtiáo , mǔzhǐ cóng nàge xiǎojié shàng niǎn guòqù .
pairs.english: Mira moved the wheel and picked up the cloth, rolling her thumb over the small knot.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把木轮移开，拿起布条，拇指从那个小结上碾过去。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhōngwǔ lái hái shū , cái fāxiàn dōngxī bèi bānzǒu .
pairs.english: She said she had only discovered it missing at noon when she came to return a book.
pairs.hanzi: 她说中午来还书，才发现东西被搬走。

pairs.target: kàn gōngfáng de lǎogōngrén zhǐ guò lìng yìjiān wū , shuō gāoniánjí yǒurén jiè qù zuò dēngjià , yǐwéi tā zǎo zhīdào .
pairs.english: The old worker looking after the workshop had pointed to another room: an older student had borrowed it for a lamp frame; he'd assumed she knew.
pairs.hanzi: 看工房的老工人指过另一间屋，说高年级有人借去做灯架，以为她早知道。

alignment.english: an older student had borrowed it

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zǒu dào ménbiān , yòu tíngzhù , wèn tā yǒuméiyǒu qù wèn .
pairs.english: Tavi reached the door, stopped, and asked if she'd spoken to them.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维走到门边，又停住，问她有没有去问。

pairs.target: tā shuō wèn guò , rén méi huílái , zhuōshàng dǎo yǒu tāmen de língjiàn .
pairs.english: She said she'd tried, but the person wasn't back; their parts, though, were on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 她说问过，人没回来，桌上倒有他们的零件。

pairs.target: nà jù " tāmen de " shuō dé hěn qīng , què ràng tǎ wéi bǐ tīngjiàn jiàomà hái nánshòu .
pairs.english: She said “their” quietly, but it hurt Tavi more than shouting would have.
pairs.hanzi: 那句“他们的”说得很轻，却让塔维比听见叫骂还难受。

pairs.target: gébì wū nuǎn xiē , lú páng bǎi zhe bàn rén gāo de mùjià , dǐngshàng yǒu liǎngdào héng cáo , néng bǎ dēngzuò cóng yìbiān huá dào lìngyìbiān .
pairs.english: The next room was warmer. Beside the stove stood a waist-high wooden frame with two tracks across the top for sliding lamp bases from side to side.
pairs.hanzi: 隔壁屋暖些，炉旁摆着半人高的木架，顶上有两道横槽，能把灯座从一边滑到另一边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènchū le dǐxià nà zhī qiǎn tiě cáo : nèijiǎo yǒu yídào mó bú diào de xiǎo huàhén , shì tā dìyīhuí zhé wāi hòu liúxià de .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized the shallow iron channel below: inside was the stubborn scratch from his first crooked bend.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认出了底下那只浅铁槽：内角有一道磨不掉的小划痕，是他第一回折歪后留下的。

pairs.target: mù qiáoliáng bèi chāichéng liǎngduàn , gē zài dìshàng .
pairs.english: The wooden bridge beam lay on the floor in two pieces.
pairs.hanzi: 木桥梁被拆成两段，搁在地上。

pairs.target: yígè gāoniánjí nánshēng cóng hòumén jìnlái , bào zhe gāng páo hǎo de mùtiáo .
pairs.english: An older boy came through the back door carrying freshly planed strips of wood.
pairs.hanzi: 一个高年级男生从后门进来，抱着刚刨好的木条。

pairs.target: tā bǐ tǎ wéi gāo bàngè tóu , xiùzǐ juàn zhe , kànjiàn mǐlā shǒulǐ de hóngbù , lìkè zhīdào tāmen wèishénme lái .
pairs.english: He was half a head taller than Tavi, his sleeves rolled up. Seeing the red cloth in Mira's hand, he immediately knew why they had come.
pairs.hanzi: 他比塔维高半个头，袖子卷着，看见米拉手里的红布，立刻知道他们为什么来。

pairs.target: " wǒ shì tèlún . " tā shuō , " běnlái xiǎng děng zhuāng hǎo zài zhǎo nǐ . "
pairs.english: “I'm Teren,” he said. “I meant to find you once it was assembled.”
pairs.hanzi: “我是特伦。”他说，“本来想等装好再找你。”

pairs.target: mǐlā wèn wèishénme bú zài chāi yǐqián zhǎo .
pairs.english: Mira asked why he hadn't found her before taking it apart.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉问为什么不在拆以前找。

pairs.target: tèlún bǎ mùtiáo kào hǎo , shuō xiǎo zhǎn chè xiàlái de dōngxī dōu zài tóngyígè jiàzi shàng , pángbiān jǐjiàn yǐjīng chāihuí liào xiāng .
pairs.english: Teren propped the strips up, saying the dismantled exhibition pieces were all on one shelf and some nearby had already gone back into the scrap box.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦把木条靠好，说小展撤下来的东西都在同一个架子上，旁边几件已经拆回料箱。

pairs.target: tā wèn guò kàn wū de rén , duìfāng shuō búyòng de kěyǐ ná . tā yǐwéi zhèjiàn yě suàn .
pairs.english: He had asked the caretaker, who said unused things could be taken. He thought this counted too.
pairs.hanzi: 他问过看屋的人，对方说不用的可以拿。他以为这件也算。

pairs.target: " shàngtóu yǒu wǒ de míngzì . "
pairs.english: “My name was on it.”
pairs.hanzi: “上头有我的名字。”

pairs.target: " wǒ kàndào le . wǒ méi shuō zhè tiě cáo shì wǒ zuò de . "
pairs.english: “I saw it. I never said I made this iron channel.”
pairs.hanzi: “我看到了。我没说这铁槽是我做的。”

pairs.target: tā cóng zhuōxià náchū yìzhāng pái , xiě zhe " xuéshēng hé zhì dēngjià ".
pairs.english: From under the table he took a sign reading “Student-built lamp frame.”
pairs.hanzi: 他从桌下拿出一张牌，写着“学生合制灯架”。

pairs.target: mǐlā kàn wán , wèn nǎjǐgè xuéshēng .
pairs.english: Mira read it and asked which students.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉看完，问哪几个学生。

pairs.target: tèlún shuō háiyǒu liǎnggè tóngniánjí de , yígè zuò huálún , yígè zuò guàgōu , tú yě shì tāmen zhònghuà de , zhè yǐjīng búshì yuánlái de qiáo .
pairs.english: Teren said two others in his year, one making the pulley and one the hook; they had redrawn the plans, and this was no longer the original bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦说还有两个同年级的，一个做滑轮，一个做挂钩，图也是他们重画的，这已经不是原来的桥。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rěnbúzhù zhǐzhe dìshàng de mùtiáo , shuō dāngrán búshì , qiáo yǐjīng gěi tā chāi le .
pairs.english: Tavi couldn't help pointing at the wood on the floor: of course it wasn't, since he had dismantled the bridge.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忍不住指着地上的木条，说当然不是，桥已经给他拆了。

pairs.target: wūlǐ jìng le yíxià . lúzǐ lǐ de huǒ hěn xiǎng ,
pairs.english: The room fell quiet a moment, the fire loud in the stove.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里静了一下。炉子里的火很响，

pairs.target: tèlún xiàbā bēngjǐn , yòu sōngkāi .
pairs.english: Teren's jaw tightened, then relaxed.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦下巴绷紧，又松开。

pairs.target: tā shuō qiáo zhǐshì zhuōshàng de yǎnshì , zhè jiàzi shì zhēnde néng huàndēng wèi ,
pairs.english: He said the bridge was only a tabletop demonstration, while this frame could truly change lamp positions.
pairs.hanzi: 他说桥只是桌上的演示，这架子是真的能换灯位，

pairs.target: guò wǔtiān gōngfáng kāifàng , yǒu chénglǐ de rén láikàn , tāmen yǐjīng bào le zhè yíjiàn .
pairs.english: In five days the workshop would open to city visitors, and they had already entered this piece.
pairs.hanzi: 过五天工房开放，有城里的人来看，他们已经报了这一件。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ páizi fàngxià .
pairs.english: Mira set down the sign.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把牌子放下。

pairs.target: " wǒ de dōngxī dé zhēn guà qǐ dēng , cái zhídé xiān wèn yíjù ? "
pairs.english: “My work has to hang real lamps before it's worth asking me first?”
pairs.hanzi: “我的东西得真挂起灯，才值得先问一句？”

pairs.target: tèlún shuō tā búshì nàge yìsī , shēnshǒu xiǎng bǎ tiě cáo qǔ gěi tā , què fāxiàn shàngtóu yā zhe xīnzhuāng de zhīzuò .
pairs.english: Teren said that wasn't what he meant and reached to remove the channel for her, then found the new support pressing on it.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦说他不是那个意思，伸手想把铁槽取给她，却发现上头压着新装的支座。

pairs.target: luódīng yǐjīng chuānguò yuánlái de kǒng , zài nǐng chūlái , bànbiān dēngjià jiù dé chóngxīn zhǎo wèizhì .
pairs.english: Screws now passed through the old holes; removing them meant repositioning half the lamp frame.
pairs.hanzi: 螺钉已经穿过原来的孔，再拧出来，半边灯架就得重新找位置。

pairs.target: tā de shǒu tíng zài mùjià shàng .
pairs.english: His hand stopped on the frame.
pairs.hanzi: 他的手停在木架上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō chāi .
pairs.english: Tavi said, take it apart.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说拆。

pairs.target: tā shuō dé hěnkuài , xiàng zhǐyào luódīng tuìchū lái , gāngcái nàxiē huà yě néng tuìhuíqù .
pairs.english: He said it quickly, as though backing the screws out would take back those words too.
pairs.hanzi: 他说得很快，像只要螺钉退出来，刚才那些话也能退回去。

pairs.target: mǐlā què méiyǒu gēnzhe shuō .
pairs.english: But Mira did not echo him.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉却没有跟着说。

pairs.target: tā rào dào jiàzi lìngyìbiān , kàn le nà kuài xīn zhīzuò , yòu dītóu kàn zìjǐ mù liáng shàng duōchū de kǒng .
pairs.english: She went around the frame, studied the new support, then looked down at the extra holes in her beam.
pairs.hanzi: 她绕到架子另一边，看了那块新支座，又低头看自己木梁上多出的孔。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng zhe tā fāhuǒ , tā zhī wèn yuánlái de xiǎo mùkuài zài nǎér .
pairs.english: Tavi waited for her to flare up, but she only asked where the original little blocks were.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等着她发火，她只问原来的小木块在哪儿。

pairs.target: tèlún cóng hélǐ fān chū sānkuài . shǎo le dìsìkuài , tā zhǎo le dìèrgè hézi , réng méi zhǎodào .
pairs.english: Teren found three in a box. The fourth was missing; he searched a second box and still couldn't find it.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦从盒里翻出三块。少了第四块，他找了第二个盒子，仍没找到。

pairs.target: " wǒhuì bǔ . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “I'll replace it,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “我会补。”他说。

pairs.target: " nǐ xiān bié zài tì wǒ zuò juédìng . "
pairs.english: “Don't make any more decisions for me yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “你先别再替我做决定。”

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ sānkuài mùtou zhuāngjìn yīdài , méi ná tiě cáo , yě méi dāying jiè .
pairs.english: Mira put the three blocks in her pocket. She did not take the channel or agree to lend it.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把三块木头装进衣袋，没拿铁槽，也没答应借。

pairs.target: tā shuō jīnwǎn búyào zài dòng , míngtiān bǎ kàn wū de rén yíkuài jiào lái , nòngqīngchǔ shuí shuō guò shénme .
pairs.english: She said not to touch it again tonight; tomorrow they would bring the caretaker in and establish who had said what.
pairs.hanzi: 她说今晚不要再动，明天把看屋的人一块叫来，弄清楚谁说过什么。

pairs.target: tèlún diǎntóu shí , kàn le yǎn ménwài , yòu wèn néng bunéng bié zài zǒuláng lǐ hǎn .
pairs.english: As Teren nodded, he glanced outside and asked if they could avoid shouting in the corridor.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦点头时，看了眼门外，又问能不能别在走廊里喊。

pairs.target: tā shuō zìjǐ yìzhí méi hǎn .
pairs.english: She said she hadn't been shouting.
pairs.hanzi: 她说自己一直没喊。

pairs.target: chūlái yǐhòu , tǎ wéi xīnlǐ nà gǔ huǒ hái méixiāo .
pairs.english: Outside, Tavi's anger still burned.
pairs.hanzi: 出来以后，塔维心里那股火还没消。

pairs.target: tā shuō tèlún jiùshì xiǎng gǎn zài tā fāxiàn yǐqián zhuāng hǎo , dàoshíhòu shuí dōu bùhǎo chāi .
pairs.english: He said Teren simply wanted it assembled before she found out, so no one would feel able to dismantle it.
pairs.hanzi: 他说特伦就是想赶在她发现以前装好，到时候谁都不好拆。

pairs.target: mǐ lāzǒu le jǐbù , shuō yěxǔ shì , kě tā bùxiǎng ràng tā tì zìjǐ bǎ méi tīngjiàn dehuà dōu dìng xiàlái .
pairs.english: Mira walked a few paces, then said perhaps, but she didn't want him deciding for her all the things he hadn't heard.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉走了几步，说也许是，可她不想让他替自己把没听见的话都定下来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tíng le zuǐ . tā yuán xiǎng zhàn zài tā zhèbiān , zhàn dé tài jí , chàdiǎn yòu bǎ tā jǐ dào pángbiān qù le .
pairs.english: Tavi fell silent. He had meant to stand beside her, but rushed so much he nearly pushed her aside again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维停了嘴。他原想站在她这边，站得太急，差点又把她挤到旁边去了。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ hóngbùtiáo gěi tā kàn , wèn shìbushì hěnshǎ , zìjǐ gāngcái zuì xiǎng ná huílái de jìngshì zhège .
pairs.english: Mira showed him the red cloth and asked if it was foolish that this had been what she most wanted back.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把红布条给他看，问是不是很傻，自己刚才最想拿回来的竟是这个。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō bù shǎ , yòu shuō tiě cáo tā yě rènde , huàn le dìfāng yě rènde .
pairs.english: Tavi said no; he recognized the channel too, even in a different place.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说不傻，又说铁槽他也认得，换了地方也认得。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu xiào , zhī bǎ bùtiáo shōu hǎo .
pairs.english: She didn't smile, only put the cloth away.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有笑，只把布条收好。

pairs.target: gōngfáng wài xīn tiē le kāifàngrì de gàoshì , xiàmiàn liè zhe dēngjià , liángjù hé běi chà lù tú .
pairs.english: A new open-day notice outside the workshop listed the lamp frame, measuring instruments, and the Northfork route map.
pairs.hanzi: 工房外新贴了开放日的告示，下面列着灯架、量具和北汊路图。

pairs.target: jǐgè rén wéizhe kàn , shuí yě bù zhīdào gé yìdǔ qiáng fāshēng guò shénme .
pairs.english: Several people gathered to read it, unaware of what had happened one wall away.
pairs.hanzi: 几个人围着看，谁也不知道隔一堵墙发生过什么。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn yīwén de míngzì xiě zài lù tú jiǎngjiě nà yìlán , pángbiān yǒurén huà le yìkē xiǎo xīng .
pairs.english: Tavi saw Iven's name in the map-explanation column, with a little star drawn beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见伊文的名字写在路图讲解那一栏，旁边有人画了一颗小星。

pairs.target: mǐ lāzǒu yuǎn yìdiǎn cái shuō , míngtiān dé xiānjiè dào jiù qiáo cè .
pairs.english: Only farther away did Mira say she still needed to borrow the old bridge book tomorrow.

pairs.english: She hadn't finished studying the lateral drawing and wouldn't stop because someone else wanted to exhibit a lamp frame.

pairs.english: The place name he had brought home was still in the dormitory, but another question now stood before them, unable to wait for him to wash his face.
